headline: Motilal Oswal 5-Year G-Sec FoF Direct Plan listed on Univest
hook: Micro-cap fund listing on financial platform
summary: Motilal Oswal's 5-Year G-Sec Fund of Funds Direct Plan has been listed on the Univest platform. This routine product availability update affects retail investors using Univest to track or invest in mutual funds. For an Indian retail investor, it simply adds another platform channel for gilt fund investments.
why_it_matters: New platform availability for existing gilt funds.
